# Tenis Kosmos

> Tennis school and club in Novi Sad, Serbia, playing on the 5 Meridiana courts. Book a court online with instant confirmation, or request a training callback — no registration or account needed.

Tenis Kosmos (formally TSU "Kosmos") is a tennis academy in Novi Sad run by coaches Ratko and Ivan. The website does two things:

- **Book a court** — pick a day, a duration (1–2 hours) and a time slot (start times every 30 minutes); the court is held and confirmed instantly by email.
- **Request training** — leave a name and phone number; a coach calls back to agree on a time. Training prices are quoted on the call, not shown online.

Prices are fair, the courts are well kept, and the atmosphere is family-friendly. The interface is available in Serbian (default), English, and Russian.

## Booking

- [Book a court or request training](https://teniskosmos.com/): The single booking page and the home of the site.

## Location and contact

- [Open in Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Stojana+Novakovica+2+Novi+Sad): Stojana Novakovića 2, 21000 Novi Sad, Serbia.
- [Call the club](tel:+381628022602): +381 62 8022602.
